patch_list: Removes in-app Google Mobile Ads (interstitial, rewarded, and banner ads) for an uninterrupted mushroom foraging experience.
Disables Android FLAG_SECURE window restrictions to allow screenshots and screen recording across all ShroomID mushroom identification and field guide screens.

Unlocks full lifetime Premium & Pro subscription features in ShroomID, including AI mushroom identification, detailed edibility guides, spore prints, offline database access, and removes Adapty paywalls.
